sourceFile: 06. BRS-161014 Report test change Coil 3D dimension 17.1.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has a plausible Normal vs Test COIL function comparison but dimension and defect-detail grouping need correction before final use.
issues: Dimension outcome cites only the header, not sample rows.
Changed factor wording misses the actual coil dimension change from the content.
Function judgement overstates improvement with 10 test units vs 799 normal units.
Function defect category stats are grouped as measurements and appear unreliable.
Row 32 is cited but not shown in context for verification.
correctionPlan: Add actual dimension sample rows and separate left/right or before/after columns if present.
Restate changed factor as coil 3D dimension change, with Normal/Test COIL as compared conditions.
Change function judgement to directional with sample-size limitation unless validation criteria support improvement.
Remove or regroup defect-category measurement stats under function defects with proper row citations.
Include cited header row 32 and all supporting data rows in evidence.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient for dimension statistics and some grouping claims.
